title: Ballz's RPG datapack
description: This datapack adds a firework fueled RPG.
body: This datapack adds a craftable firework fueled Rocket Launcher (RPG), crafted using some netherite and four iron blocks. It can hold up to 4 rockets at once, and has a good firerate, similar to the Team Fortress 2 rocket launcher. And yes, you can rocet jump with it.
